narr: Showers and thunderstorms occurred along a cold front moving through the Ohio Valley during the afternoon hours. Some of the storms produced damaging winds and locally heavy rainfall.
ev: A portion of Claxon Ridge Road was washed out along Elk Lick Creek.
Several inches of water was flowing across portions of State Route 8 between Vanceburg and Garrison.
lsr: A PORTION OF CLAXON RIDGE ROAD WAS WASHED OUT. TIME ESTIMATED.
WATER WAS REPORTED FLOWING ACROSS SEVERAL PORTIONS OF KENTUCKY ROUTE 8 FROM NEAR VANCEBURG TO NEAR GARRISON.
